protocol.split: Reserved evaluation, never included in any development/training manifest before initial frozen evaluation.
protocol.annotation: Assistant visual estimates on source images and enlarged grids. Generic COCO boxes were reviewed, duplicate/merged proposals removed or corrected, and missed distinguishable bodies added. No model support predictions were displayed.
protocol.identity: Image-local IDs, not trajectories. This set does not establish identity-switch accuracy.
protocol.completeness: Only individually distinguishable bodies are labeled. The final crowd frames have unresolved fully occluded dancers. Do not report whole-roster detection precision/recall from this annotation set or call an unmatched prediction false solely because it has no label.
protocol.target: Center of primary lower-body floor supports: midpoint of planted feet, grounded knees, or visible seat contact; a one-knee/one-foot lunge uses the midpoint of those two supports. Hands alone are used when they alone support the dancer. Hidden and uncertain have no fabricated coordinate.
protocol.mixed_contact_note: M records the combination of a grounded knee and planted foot, as seen during heldout annotation. This is descriptive metadata only; no new model output class or training change was introduced.
protocol.uncertainty: Several source pixels of visual uncertainty; extreme blur/contact ambiguity excluded as uncertain. Labels require independent teammate review before being treated as final ground truth.

evaluation_precommit.oracle_crops: Use every labeled box as a crop, with frozen checkpoint/decoder/threshold; compare against the bottom-center of the same reviewed box. No threshold optimization on these labels.
evaluation_precommit.end_to_end: One-to-one Hungarian box matching at IoU0.5 against observed or short predicted boxes. Unmatched visible references count as missing positions. Also report observed-only matches and IoU0.3 as sensitivity, never choose settings by either result.
metrics: correct fraction at1/2/3/5percent mat-width error including misses
median/p90 error among available points, with coverage
matched hidden contacts emitted as measured
paired continuity without claiming it measures accuracy
evaluation_precommit.geometry: Existing homography and assumed1.6aspect ratio, unchanged. Relative units, not meters.
evaluation_precommit.frame_correlation: Nine correlated frames from one11.24-second section; not independent clips or proof of generalization.
